offers_products.reason: Designs and manufactures emission-certified engines and power systems for industrial, transportation and power generation OEMs.

offers_services.reason: Engineering, testing and integration support the engine sales; services are not a separate main offering.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Sells engines and power systems to OEMs and end-user businesses, not households.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Main buyers are industrial and power system OEMs making forklifts, generators, terminal tractors and similar equipment.

recurring_revenue.reason: OEMs repeatedly reorder engines for ongoing production, plus aftermarket parts; repeat buying dominates even without long contracts.

cyclical_demand.reason: Engine demand follows OEM equipment production such as forklifts, construction and industrial machinery, which is cut in downturns.

big_ticket.reason: Engines are components bought repeatedly in production volumes by OEMs, not large infrequent purchases.

people_delivered.reason: Customers pay for manufactured engines and power systems, not staff time.

large_customers.reason: Customers are mainly large OEMs in power systems, industrial and transportation markets, including data center power packagers.

asset_heavy.reason: Runs ISO-certified engine manufacturing and testing facilities; heavy manufacturing needs ongoing plant investment.
